property_summary: For any call to c's fallback with a msg.value other than 10 ether, the reference C always reverts (the 10-ether guard rejects it), whereas the mutant accepts any value and updates pastBlockTime, so a call with a wrong value succeeds there, breaking the rule for some fuzzed value.
change_summary: Delete the require(msg.value == 10 ether) guard so calls with any value succeed and update pastBlockTime, changing the observable value.
